item.title: How Retailers Are Using AI to Optimize Store Layouts and Boost Sales
item.description: Ensuring visibility is a challenge of space planning. Historically, retailers relied on static floor plans or sent district managers to visit stores semi-regularly to understand their spaces before changes. This approach created blind spots — layouts looked one way on paper but functioned differently in practice, and problems often went unnoticed until they affected sales.
